notes: «علي» is a bare name, written as it stands
the appositive «رجل من ولد قنبر الكبير مولى أبي الحسن الرضا» describes القنبري and is left out (rule 1); the Qanbari is the speaker of the saying, so he is the last link
no Imam is named in the words after the chain; «جعفر» in the story is its subject
